title: The Crime Scene Investigation
description: Forensic cold case breakdown with atmospheric analog grading, tension pacing, and reconstructed crime scene sequences.

caseStudy.overview: Transforming over 30 hours of raw investigative recordings and crime scene photographs into a gripping 12-minute documentary segment.
caseStudy.challenge: Maintaining dramatic tension without sensationalizing real tragedy, while presenting complex forensic timelines clearly.
caseStudy.solution: Built a three-act timeline structure with evidence-board pacing, slow push-ins on archival documents, and low-frequency sonic tension.
techniques: Pacing and tension building across narrative acts
Spatial audio design with police radio filters
Cold filmic LUTs with pushed shadows

title: Cold Case Dossier
description: Investigative documentary exploring unsolved archival files, timeline mapping, and psychological suspense rhythm.

caseStudy.overview: Condensing decades of unsolved mystery archives into a structured, cinematic visual investigation.
caseStudy.challenge: Balancing disparate archival formats (VHS, microfilm, telephone audio) into a single cohesive broadcast edit.
caseStudy.solution: Uniform 2.39:1 letterboxing with grain mapping and unified analog sound design.
techniques: Tension risers and room tone design

title: The Interrogation Tape
description: High-suspense interrogation breakdown blending audio restoration, micro-expression cutaways, and low-end drone soundscapes.

caseStudy.overview: Frame-by-frame scrutiny of historic interrogation footage with psychological rhythm cuts.
caseStudy.challenge: Creating high retention around seated dialogue without artificial or distracting effects.
caseStudy.solution: Punch-ins on gestures, sub-bass heartbeat pulses, and strategic room silences.

title: Shadows Of The Evidence
description: Investigative narrative examining forensic witness logs and police evidence boards with dark cinematic pacing.

caseStudy.overview: Evidence board storytelling connecting complex witness timelines and contradictory testimonies.
caseStudy.challenge: Preventing viewer fatigue across dense legal and investigative details.
caseStudy.solution: Dynamic 2.5D camera pushes across interconnected evidence files and maps.

title: Unsolved Anatomy
description: Deep investigative piece analyzing timeline discrepancies, forensic crime files, and location transit maps.

caseStudy.overview: Forensic reconstruction of key alibis with pinpoint chronological visual aids.
caseStudy.challenge: Structuring rapid temporal jumps between past events and modern investigation.
caseStudy.solution: Distinct color treatments and auditory cues separating historic archive from present-day analysis.

title: The Final Verdict
description: A multi-layered 6-part docuseries finale cut tracking courtroom revelations, archival news clips, and tension-heavy sound design.

caseStudy.overview: The dramatic conclusion to an investigative docuseries bringing together forensic testimony and verdict reveals.
caseStudy.challenge: Delivering an emotionally satisfying climax with sustained dramatic suspense.
caseStudy.solution: Accelerating editorial rhythm culminating in a quiet, high-impact final sequence.

title: Kinetic Identity Motion
description: Precise kinetic typography and visual identity motion designed with custom speed curves and rhythmic transitions.

caseStudy.overview: Exploration of typographic weight transitions and smooth camera movement for brand identity.
caseStudy.challenge: Achieving organic movement without rubbery or exaggerated overshoot.
caseStudy.solution: Custom mathematical Bezier speed graph curves paired with subtle sound effects.

title: Dynamic Brand Systems
description: Comprehensive motion system showcasing fluid brand choreography, logo movement, and cinematic title design.

caseStudy.overview: Building an extensible motion design language for high-impact visual branding.
caseStudy.challenge: Maintaining maximum legibility while delivering energetic, multi-layered visual animations.
caseStudy.solution: Structured hierarchical layering where secondary animations support focal points.

title: Health Risk Infographic Animation
description: Engaging infographic explainer animating complex health metrics, risk factors, and data points with clear visual hierarchy.

caseStudy.overview: Translating dense medical and statistical risk factors into clear, digestible, animated visual storytelling.
caseStudy.challenge: Communicating critical health information without causing viewer overload.
caseStudy.solution: Modular iconography, color-coded risk indicators, and rhythmic animated callouts.
